channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Gersson Rosas | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Gersson Rosas from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Chris Finch on Gersson Rosas
item.description:
Chris Finch on the Wolves offseason:

“I think we made great strides in addressing the needs. I think the front office, Gersson and his crew, did a really good job. We had limited bullets this year. We weren't in the draft, but we had priorities and we nailed every single one.”

Chris Finch on Gersson Rosas, Sep 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Glen Taylor, Gersson Rosas
item.description:
Chauncey Billups:

“I liked the Minnesota situation. They have some good people. I love (owner Glen Taylor) so I was attracted to the situation. Interviewed well, but obviously they went with Gersson Rosas, who was a very good candidate and I’m sure will do a terrific job. But even with that situation, they reached out to me.”

Chauncey Billups on Glen Taylor, Gersson Rosas, Aug 3, 2019. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Pablo Prigioni on Gersson Rosas
item.description:
“I’m thrilled to be joining the Minnesota Timberwolves staff and be a part of what Gersson and Ryan are building here in Minnesota,”

Pablo Prigioni on Gersson Rosas, Jun 25, 2019. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Jarrett Culver on Gersson Rosas
item.description:
Darren Wolfson:Culver on his call with Rosas/#Twolves front office earlier tonight:

“Their energy was amazing... I want to be where they want me.”

Jarrett Culver on Gersson Rosas, Jun 20, 2019. Source: Twitter @DWolfsonKSTP.

item.title: Andrew Wiggins on Gersson Rosas
item.description:
Rosas has met with Wiggins several times, professing his support for him, belief in him and expectations that improvement will come starting now.

“I came and met Gersson with some of my family, and he was amazing,”

Andrew Wiggins on Gersson Rosas, Jun 18, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Ryan Saunders on Gersson Rosas
item.description:
Ryan Saunders:

“I look forward to building on what we established last season in terms of instilling a positive environment for our players to grow on and off the court. I’m excited to collaborate with Gersson and our staff to build a winning team that we can all be proud of.”

Ryan Saunders on Gersson Rosas, May 20, 2019. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Gersson Rosas, Tilman Fertitta
item.description:
“I'd love to be with the Rockets for life. This obviously solidifies us for a little while. I'm just really thankful to Tilman Fertitta for having the faith in our team. And really, it is about us having a team of people that makes this all work; Coach (Mike) D'Antoni, (vice president) Keith Jones, (vice president) Gersson Rosas, (trainer) Jason Biles, (assistant general manager) Monte McNair, (assistant general manager) Eli Witus, (assistant general manager, Vipers GM) Jimmy Paulis.”

Daryl Morey on Gersson Rosas, Tilman Fertitta, Mar 13, 2019. Source: Houston Chronicle.
